Field Descriptions

LIMIT

APT proportion threshold for 4-bit samples. Maximum allowed count of most common 4-bit pattern in a 128-sample window. For unbiased source, expect ~8 (6.25%). Default=32 allows up to 25%. Reduce to ~12-15 to detect 4-bit pattern bias. Test fails if pattern count exceeds this limit.
